sentence: This project tests how stem cells help the intestine recover after injury, using an implantable device to deliver the cells.
This project studies which molecules change the strength of electrical synapses in the auditory pathway.
This project studies how a transcriptional regulator changes the protective functions of marginal zone B cells in atherosclerosis.
This project offers imaging tools, including magnetic resonance imaging and ultrasound, to study cancer in rats and mice.
This project studies how sugars on the surface of cancer cells add to disease progression and tries to build therapies that target them.
This project offers microscopes and imaging skills so cancer researchers can study animals, organs and cells.
This project uses a machine that reads long stretches of DNA and RNA and detects changes in them.
This project tests a gene therapy that uses CRISPR base editing to switch off or adjust a genetic contributor to Parkinson's disease.
This project builds cross-linking methods to study how molecules in cells interact during heat stress.
This project uses human lung cell lines to find out how gene mutations cause childhood interstitial lung disease and to find medications for it.
This project builds computational tools to track how metastatic breast cancer tumors change and spread and to find vulnerabilities.
This project tests whether a lipid molecule protects microglia from the harm that arsenic causes.
This project develops antiviral agents that fight herpes simplex virus and prevent partner transmission.
This project studies whether blocking a protein helps tumors respond to immunotherapy.
This project tests whether more support helps older adults finish advance care planning before surgery.
This project studies how large chromosomal rearrangements change traits and evolve in three insect systems.
This project studies how syndecan-2, made by bone marrow stromal cells, affects hematopoiesis.
This project develops methods to work out who needs HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis and whether that need is being met.
This project studies the role of genomic instability and hypoxia in preeclampsia.
